entries.version: v1.0.10 — Admin Security Hardening, Data Persistence & Public UI Clean-Up
changes: Public UI Clean-Up: completely removed all public 'Admin Login', 'Admin Portal', and 'Sign In' links and buttons from the top navigation bar, command search dialog (⌘K), mobile menu drawer, and website footer. No normal site visitor can see or click into the admin panel.

Subscriber Data Persistence: built a dual-layer persistence system (saveSubscriber) combining Prisma database storage with an in-memory/persistent store fallback (src/lib/db/memoryStore.ts). Form submissions from /lab, /contact, and / now persist instantly with zero data loss.

Admin Control Center Overhaul: redesigned /admin/dashboard into a full control center featuring executive metric cards, real-time subscriber directory table with search filter & CSV export, support helpdesk logs, and JSON content inspector.
ShelfMaster Complete Removal: purged all legacy ShelfMaster desktop software data, routes, image assets, and legal references site-wide.
Official Legal Documents: updated official 8-section Privacy Policy (/legal/privacy) and 12-section Terms of Use (/legal/terms) from official PDF specifications.

changes: Streamlined site footer: removed 'Pre-Launch Registration' and 'Upcoming Studio Tools' menu items, removed engineering accreditation block, and eliminated the footer subscription form in favor of a clean, responsive 4-column architecture (Brand, Software Suite, Documentation & Help, Legal & Standards).

Studio Lab (/lab) page subscription overhaul: replaced legacy sign-up form with the integrated, production-grade SubscriberForm component inside a dedicated Subscription Form card directly wired to /api/subscribe with real-time feedback and validation.
Content cleanup: purged outdated and redundant copy from the /lab page, including 'Zero spam guarantee...', 'Launch Timeline Status', and directory review notices.

System & build stabilization: decoupled client components from server modules by introducing dedicated server API routes (/api/admin/login and /api/admin/subscribers), implemented lazy Prisma initialization with graceful fallback mode, eliminated native module client bundle constraints, and silenced static mailer resolution.
